name: Superrappin'
artist: Grandmaster Flash and the Furious Five

podcast.body: Released in 1979, this track is highlighted as another early modern rap release that could equally have been credited as a historical milestone in the genre's development, similar to Sugarhill Gang's "Rapper's Delight." "en mismo año gran master flash and the fouries five en 1979 acaban el super rapping."
